+前回まで未収録だった`0x44F6F4～0x44F6FC`と、その後の処理を既存の保存済みアセンブリから発見しました。

+
+| アドレス | 確認した動作 |
+|---|---|
+| `0x44F6EF` | 引数評価helper `0x452860` |
+| `0x44F6F4` | 追加引数を取得 |
+| `0x44F6FA` | 一時領域を準備 |

+# REA batch9 complete-body recovery
+
+Checked 2026-11-05. Coordinator-supplied repository base `c8b9686` was not independently queried through Git. Exactly 45 literal Markdown paths in `hakushin-rea-batch9-approved.tsv` received complete bounded UTF-8 body review (167,656 original bytes). Built-in local execution fallback after connector HTTP429 was coordinator-authorized; Remote tools used: zero.
+
+Archived: **41 complete byte-identical reports and four complete privacy-only derivatives**. Exact baseline aliases: 0; within-batch aliases: 0; same-filename differing-body variants: 0; approved-body deferrals: 0. There are 23 historical research IDs. Primary/readback roles remain independent; no paired bodies were collapsed and no duplicate body was written. All 45 paths are absent from the old catalog snapshot. Current measured hashes are not represented as approved hashes: the selection supplied only expected sizes and blank hash fields.
+
+`REPORT_LEDGER.tsv` uses the root recovery ledger's nine columns. `INPUT_RECEIPTS.tsv` identifies the exact selection and baseline metadata snapshots by relative label, size and SHA256. `SELECTION_RECEIPTS.tsv` accounts for all 45 literal inputs in selection order. `CURRENT_SOURCE_METADATA.tsv` supplements the old catalog with measured source hash, byte size, timestamp and old-catalog presence. `IDENTITY_RECEIPTS.tsv` preserves historical IDs, statuses, roles and collision checks. Source-manifest and recovery-ledger destination hashes were compared against complete source/derivative hashes without opening baseline bodies.
+
+## Privacy and complete-body proof
+
+Four readbacks (Oct25 02H owner argument, Oct25 01H manager gate, Oct24 22H vector lifetime, Oct24 2137 child RTTI slots) contain a personal local absolute research path. Each derivative replaces only that token with `[PRIVATE_LOCAL_RESEARCH_PATH]`; all authored text before and after it, including original line endings, is retained. `TRANSFORM_RECEIPTS.tsv` records the original source/body hashes, original token SHA256, zero-based half-open UTF-8 byte offsets, replacement token/byte length, complete sizes and prefix/suffix hashes. No personal path is repeated in metadata. The other 41 receipts prove whole-body identity. Literal escaped newline strings in historical error accounts are not private UNC paths and remain intact.
+
+## Held scope and historical refusals
+
+`DEFERRED.tsv` maintains metadata-only rows for 5710C0..571500, 58021E..580340, 5769B0, downstream 5767B0, whole FUN00580280 including later offsets, refused rsc3/rsc4 tables, T029 postbattle castle, prior-refused helper 5BC860, helper 004BC9C0 and other prior-refused helper bodies/dependencies. No approved report substantively reproduces these held bodies or depends on their contents. These generic held rows have blank `source_path`; there is no approved report with a blank ledger destination.
+
+The Oct24 2035 branch matrix records the historical refusal to start a new 004BC9C0 function query and explicitly leaves its pseudo-C/ABI and individual callee internals unacquired. Earlier 20H and later independent ArmyChip documents preserve only an opaque caller-site edge and refusal/no-retry history. They do not recover that helper body, infer its implementation, or authorize another query. The branch matrix is a derived logical model with eight possible combinations, not proof of eight reachable game states. The 2137 RTTI document narrows that model only for the documented fixed ArmyChip vtable, while preserving uncertainty about other types and later vptr changes. Previously deferred 5BC860 primary and all linked helper payloads were never opened.
+
+## Historical qualifications and corrections
+
+Current curated REF documents retain priority over these historical reports. STATIC, REUSED STATIC, DERIVED, SYNTHETIC, VERIFY, NOT READY, pending-readback statuses, audit/readback PASS, and old Wave1-5 64/64 remain author claims at their original times. Old rename-EPERM drift is not repaired. No native analysis, runtime observation, audit rerun, formal VERIFIED increment, READY, Golden PASS, strict MATCH or completion percentage is asserted by this recovery. Golden proposals are DESIGNED/NOT RUN.
+
+- Oct25 08H corrects the earlier ordinary allocation-failure interpretation: unchanged throwing allocator normal return is nonNULL; failed allocation with failed/absent new-handler throws rather than reaching Spot's local NULL branch. The older 03H-06H NULL/retry assertions remain present as historical claims and are SUPERSEDED/VERIFY under that correction. The presence of a JE alone does not prove normal reachability.
+- Oct25 05H corrects 04H's suggested funclet instruction starts from 71/79 to 70/78. Oct25 06H derives the S-relative saved allocation slot but leaves EBP provenance unproved. Oct25 07H supplies a conditional static normal-MSVC state1 unwind chain establishing EBP=S; it does not establish live exception behavior, general hook ABI or leak/double-free outcomes.
+- Oct25 04H separates the atexit callback's global helper ownership from direct Spot-cache destruction. Literal-reference scans do not exhaust pointer aliases or prove a leak. Atexit failure reachability and consequences remain uncertain.
+- Oct25 00H distinguishes parent deferred predicate queues from the child NULL-guarded destructor queue; initial exploratory 55/56 FAIL is SUPERSEDED and drawing calls are excluded from destructor candidates. Oct25 01H places these deletes after the inner loop exit gate, not on every tick or solely at whole-game termination. Pending-to-active transfer and same-manager claims remain conditional on owner/intermediate pointer stability.
+- Oct25 02H separates two caller owner/this value sources and leaves their manager equality unproved. Oct25 03H distinguishes name hit, fallback cache and construction returns; Ghidra void guesses do not supply approved hook types.
+- Oct24 22H-23H separate parent vector storage free, child internal-link cleanup and child object deletion. Zero direct E8 callers do not prove unused code or a leak; virtual dispatch and independent ownership remain possible.
+- Oct24 02H-09H preserve register/stack ABI limits, source-container versus output-container ownership, conditional empty reset/rebuild, outer-node insertion and inner count transfer. An outer node, a positive inner count and successful filtering are distinct conditions. Oct24 09H adds that a selected inner key can statically be zero; nonempty count does not ensure nonzero return. The three tree sentinel offsets are distinct. NULL dereference reachability and actual gameplay failure remain unobserved.
+- Oct24 0137 corrects the source-selection transfer to E9 tail JMP rather than an E8 call. +0x08 initialization and +0x0C calls are separated by substantial processing; dynamic type, NULL gates and +0x20 value at the later time remain unproved.
+- Historical quote/encoding/parser, tuple-list comparison, instruction-boundary and JSON escaped-newline failures remain visible with their corrections. Initial failed audit versions are not successful results or new recovered discoveries.

+## Scope and verification
+
+Only the 45 exact approved original Markdown bodies were opened. Baseline root manifest, source catalog, recovery ledger and prior batch8 example metadata were read for provenance/classification. No linked native/script/JSON/log/EXE/SQLite/HANDOFF/archive payload was opened or executed. No REA/Ghidra/game, historical audit, Git or Remote operation ran. Writes are restricted to the new batch9 directory; originals, root/shared metadata, product code and synced project files were not changed.

+`0x00597C32 PUSH 0x36C` → `0x00597C3D CALL 0x005B6C2B` → `0x00597C51 TEST EAX,EAX` → `0x00597C53 JE 0x00597C72` は機械語上存在する。
